package.name: armv7_rqt
package.description: Unified rqt control panel for the armv7 arm: switch POSITION and FORCE control at runtime, enable / tare the Cartesian impedance, live-tune stiffness / damping / friction, and monitor pose error, commanded wrench and the estimated external wrench — all in one dockable panel next to MoveIt's RViz. Frontend over armv7_mode_manager (mode) and the cartesian_impedance_controller (tuning + monitoring).
package.author: TianFeiF
